facts.value: Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers a wide range of opportunities.
The Global Office assists international exchange students and scholarship holders throughout their study period at Goethe University, from preparation to personal support on-site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has essential information and offerings for international postdocs, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial consultation to buddy program: Goethe University offers services for study applications, scholarships, residency rights, and much more for a successful start in Frankfurt.
Discover our diverse study offerings for international students in Frankfurt—first-class teaching, exciting research, and a vibrant campus await you.
The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully transition from studies to work in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies. Besides preparatory and language courses, the offerings include scholarships, assistance with housing searches, legal matters, financing, and integration.
Discover language offerings and opportunities for study preparation for foreign applicants at Goethe University.
